inspection.decisions: Selected the 2019 lot surface. Other images were repeated displays, decorative signs, a crowded interior, or from the pre-2012 location. A closer pharmacy display doorway was not mislabeled as a public entrance. Followed photographer Warren LeMay’s Flickr source.

Twelve event-room/library images inspected; row/table layouts and library rug are described with capture-date and setup limits. The Explore header was a decorative sign closeup and is not linked as access evidence.

Entry-panorama cube faces show interior ramp/rails, lobby counter, partial seating and bright sign displays. Original 2020-labeled tour linked. Other panorama thumbnails were fetched but not credited as inspected. Interactive browser operation could not be tested because browser host unavailable.
Historical CC0 full frame explicitly predates renovations. Reinspected all three city photographs; existing guide entry preserved without claiming a new link or an independently observed opening.
Front stair photograph linked; two stage/cast campaign photographs are not access evidence. Elevator approach remains unknown.

Selected historical entrance, curved railed walkway and Orchid House path. Other images were botanical closeups, model trains, distant exteriors, duplicate path views or an illustrated postcard. Two downloads returned429 and were left uninspected. Original entrance download also returned429; the successfully retrieved full-frame960px preview was used without enlargement. API and initial generic-client image requests returned403; ordinary identified User-Agent requests succeeded for35 previews.
Branch-page image inventory consists of marketing/food imagery and icons, with no identified pickup bay, entrance or physical branch walkthrough. No documentary access photo added.

Two indoor-pool views, welcome counter and fitness floor visually inspected. Original page linked only; capture dates and reuse licence unknown. One photo includes visitors. No claim of lift operation, transfer assistance, current pool operation or a complete entrance route.

linked_guides.title: Historical photographer tour: lobby ramp and exhibit lighting
linked_guides.description: The entry panorama shows an interior sloping walkway with railings beside a lobby counter, nearby upholstered seating and brightly lit sign displays. Four directions of this panorama were inspected. The photographer’s tour files are labeled 2020; capture dates are unconfirmed and the tour predates the July 2024 expansion. It does not verify current routes, ramp dimensions, door controls, toilets or the stair-only library. Copyright remains with the photographer; images are linked on the original tour, not republished.
linked_guides.documentDate: Tour files labeled 2020; capture dates unconfirmed

linked_guides.title: Official event-room and library photographs
linked_guides.description: Twelve inspected views show gallery audience rows and banquet tables, bright sign displays, theatre table seating and the library’s shared table, loose chairs and rug. Event arrangements vary, and several views include guests. Capture dates are unconfirmed; some library filenames refer to August 2023. The photos do not show the library stair approach or a step-free alternative, toilets, transfer space or the route from parking. The linked library FAQ separately reports one flight of stairs and no elevator. Images remain on the museum’s page; no reuse licence established.

linked_guides.title: Official front-door stair photograph
linked_guides.description: The About page’s exterior photograph shows steps with a central handrail leading to the front double doors, beside hedges. Capture date is unknown. This is a visible stair approach, not the elevator route described in the November 2026 program. The parking-to-elevator connection, thresholds, toilet interior and current condition are not shown. The image remains on the theater’s page; no reuse licence established.

linked_guides.title: Official pool, welcome-desk and fitness-floor photographs
linked_guides.description: Four inspected branch images include two views of the indoor pool and tiled deck with entry handrails, a curved welcome desk with different counter heights, and rows of fitness equipment. The fitness-floor photo includes visitors. Capture dates are unknown. These partial views do not establish a continuous entrance route, counter dimensions, pool-lift operation, transfer assistance or changing/toilet facilities, and do not resolve the conflicting pool-operation text. Images remain on the YMCA page; no reuse licence established.

linked_guides.title: Historical Taft visual narrative: entrance, lobby and restroom doors
linked_guides.description: This 2023 performance narrative includes photographs of the marquee entrance, security screening, busy lobby, restroom doors and signs, auditorium and fixed seating. Pages 2–7 were visually inspected. Photo capture dates are unstated and several views include visitors. Its food, quiet-space, sensory-bag and admission arrangements are specific to that historical performance, not current venue policy. Restroom interiors, transfer space, door controls and a continuous step-free route are not established. Linked at the original publisher; no reuse licence established.
